runtime.name: omp
runtime.configuration: Generated poteto-mode, feature, and how Skills plus the implementer role copied into a disposable Git fixture; empty Skill allowlist; one isolated task worktree with patch merge and apply=false.
runtime.permissionProfile: root read/write fixture with one bounded isolated writer and auto-approved inspection and test commands

assertions.evidence: The root explicitly loaded the generated poteto-mode router.
The root used only the generated Skills and implementer role in the disposable repository; no external Skill or plugin cache was inspected.
The router selected feature because the request intentionally added optional receipt-note behavior.
The root loaded feature and used how's simple root path to inspect createReceipt through normalization and rendering.
Before delegation the root read index.mjs, normalize-order.mjs, receipt.mjs, and the receipt test and identified the normalize-to-render boundary.
The root selected frozen { customer, note, items }, recorded empty-string omission semantics, and explained that the specified single-field behavior did not require a prototype or panel.
The root recorded the failing-test gate, overlapping ownership, lack of independent slices, and one writer as the smallest safe decomposition.
Before the worker started, the root ran node --test test/receipt.test.mjs from project/ and captured exit 1 with one pass and one missing-note failure.
The session contains exactly one NoteImplementer child and no retry or replacement.
The assignment allowed only normalize-order.mjs and receipt.mjs, and the returned patch touched exactly those paths.
OMP created an isolated writer worktree and retained its unapplied patch; the root inspected and integrated it into the disposable source checkout.
The root inspected the actual two-file diff before integration and independently confirmed the normalized-data boundary.
After integration the root reran the exact command and captured exit 0 with two passing tests.
The missing and whitespace-only note cases retained the original customer and items output.
Only the two allowed implementation files changed; test, index, generated resources, and runtime configuration hashes stayed at baseline.
The run made no commit, push, publication, or pull-request operation.

limitations: The supplied behavioral test does not exercise a non-string note; the root disclosed that boundary.
OMP delivery remains D0 overall because the separate plugin-manager D1 gate is unresolved.
